elements.element: Audit frequency no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "permitted by Licensee, no more than once per 12 months, within 30 days"

elements.element: 30 days' prior written notice of audit
elements.evidence: "except on not less than 30 days' prior written notice"
"allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional" (untouched)
"by an auditor bound by confidentiality obligations"

elements.element: Vendor bears audit cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "cost of the audit will be borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy of more than five-percent (5%) is discovered"

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
elements.evidence: "no audit shall include direct access to Licensee's systems"
"not less than 30 days' prior written notice" (exceeds 15 days)

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy of more than five-percent (5%)"

reasons: All seven atomic preferred elements are satisfied: frequency cap inserted into the operative sentence, and a single added sentence supplies 30 days' written notice, business hours, a confidentiality-bound auditor and no direct system access; the pre-existing Licensor-borne cost with the 5% discrepancy shift is retained unchanged.

Minimality is marginally exceeded: the inserted qualifier "off-site where possible" is a location requirement not called for by the preferred position and is not needed to complete any element (the no-system-access limb already handles the risk). Immaterial in effect but it is extra operative language.

Intent is preserved: mutual-agreement auditor selection, the 30-day accommodation mechanic and the cost-allocation sentence remain effective, and no undefined term, contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced (the 30-day notice sentence reads consistently with the 30-day accommodation window).
No redline is otherwise warranted; the clause now sits at the preferred level.
